name: Ajoko
tagline: A live record-keeper for rotating savings circles (ajo). It never holds anyone's money.
highlights: Whole member lifecycle, onboarding to disputes; the first real circle completed with zero defaults.
Staff back-office: monitoring, role-based access, support inbox, disputes console, audit log, announcements.
Also an agreement step, receipts and host succession; that first circle had 7 members on daily rounds.
Closed a 25-alert security pass, and self-hosted the font so the ₦ sign and Yoruba characters render correctly.

name: Marcplaats
tagline: A hyperlocal photo-spotting app (PWA), in continuous delivery since May 2026.
highlights: Business rules enforced in the database: row-level security, rate-limit triggers, CHECK constraints.
GPS-first upload with map-pin fallback, Serwist PWA, Sentry; a failing Playwright test before every feature.
Admin activity feed, push and email engagement, and ongoing security hardening.

name: Retail storefront for a Lagos phone shop
tagline: A 733-product catalogue built around WhatsApp orders, with an owner panel.
highlights: Workers, D1 and R2 store with an owner self-service panel; each WhatsApp tap counted as a conversion.
Verified its Google Business Profile; homepage indexed and 774 pages discovered in Search Console.
Brand redesign with colours sampled from the shop's own signage, plus a share card for links.

name: House of Faridah
tagline: A multi-brand site for a Nigerian interior-design and construction company, with its own CMS.
highlights: Two sub-brands in one app, an admin portal and a portfolio CMS with galleries and watermarking.
Image weight cut from 61 MB to 8.5 MB; the Interiors page is interactive in 2–9 s, down from 27–90+ s.
Per-route SEO tags, sitemap and robots fixed; dependency and security patches; a Node 22 deploy pipeline on GitHub Pages.
A copy-paste 'add a project' workflow so the client can publish new work.
